{{Top}}
[[File:Transport_size_chart.png|thumb|right|250px|Various transports (not to scale)]]
{{Quote|First of all, the term 'space transport' refers to any vessel that's bigger than a starfighter and smaller than a capital ship - of course, those boundaries aren't set in durasteel. But for the most part, space transports are defined by their function - moving people or cargo from one location to another. That could be across a space dock or across the galaxy, it all depends on the ship's capabilities and their pilot's intentions.|Sergeant Riij Brinwell, a Sector Ranger of the Parmic sector|<ref name="SWTS">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
A '''transport''' usually referred to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that carried cargo or passengers,<ref name="New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> but the term could also refer to other vehicles that performed the same function.

==Characteristics==
Transports came in a wide variety of sizes, from small [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] like the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] to massive transports that could contain thousands of tons of cargo<ref name="The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> and bays where smaller transports could dock in.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

Transports such as [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and passenger liners were not designed for military encounters and were normally unarmed and slow-moving. However, transports were easy to modify and convert into effective combat vessels, which was done by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels" /> Military organizations also adapted the transport to ferry [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and provide combat support. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] used the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] to swiftly deploy its personnel to planets below. The [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] used [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|Gauntlet fighters]] to transport Death Watch troopers and provide combat support.<ref name="SWE Gauntlet fighter">{{SWE|technology|gauntlet-fighter|Gauntlet fighter}}</ref>

A non-spacefaring vehicle that was used as a transport was the [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|Gungan bongo submarine]], an underwater transport used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWE Gungan bongo submarine">{{SWE|technology|bongo|Gungan bongo submarine}}</ref>
